evidence.title: SelFusion: Self-distillation for Diffusion Language Models
Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs

summary: Researchers introduce novel methods like Self-distillation for Diffusion Language Models and amortized distillation across post-trained LLMs to improve efficiency and performance. These techniques aim to optimize model training and deployment while preserving accuracy.
title: New AI Research Advances Model Distillation Techniques for Large Language Models
